fields.recommendation: The whole DCA course grades the teaching wells: every graded value is printed at full precision in the tier lessons (including the capstone walkthrough) and most show in a panel default state. Owner to decide whether that is acceptable for this course ("the capstone is the course, asked back", beginner m06 l02) or whether the capstone needs its own well/window and triangle that the lessons and panel defaults do not already carry.
